# Gota Framework

> Gota is a pragmatic Go (1.26+) web framework built around the REPR (Request-Endpoint-Response) design pattern on top of `net/http`, `go-chi/chi/v5`, and `go-playground/validator/v10`. It provides typed request binding and validation, automatic OpenAPI 3.1 specification generation, interactive Scalar API documentation, and zero-dependency TypeScript client SDK code generation.

## Installation

Requires Go 1.26 or newer.

```bash
go get github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota
```

Primary packages:
- `github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota` — Top-level entry point (`gota.New`, `gota.App`, `gota.Config` aliases for `repr`).
- `github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota/repr` — Core REPR router, endpoint helpers, request binding, validation, errors, streaming, OpenAPI, TypeScript codegen, and security auditing.
- `github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota/scalar` — Standalone or integrated Scalar API Reference UI handler, themes, SRI, and CSP configuration.

## Quick Start

```go
package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota"
	"github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota/repr"
	"github.com/carlosxfelipe/gota/scalar"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
)

type GetUserRequest struct {
	ID string `param:"id" doc:"User ID" example:"usr_1" validate:"required"`
}

type UserResponse struct {
	ID   string `json:"id" example:"usr_1"`
	Name string `json:"name" example:"Ada Lovelace"`
}

func main() {
	app := gota.New(repr.Config{
		Title:                 "My API",
		Version:               "1.0.0",
		Description:           "Example Gota service.",
		DisallowUnknownFields: true,
		Scalar: scalar.Config{
			Theme:      scalar.ThemeFastify,
			Layout:     "classic",
			CSPEnforce: true,
		},
	})

	app.Use(middleware.RequestID, middleware.Logger, middleware.Recoverer)

	repr.Get(app, "/users/{id}", func(ctx *repr.Context, req GetUserRequest) (UserResponse, error) {
		return UserResponse{ID: req.ID, Name: "Ada Lovelace"}, nil
	}).
		Summary("Get user by ID").
		Tags("Users").
		ErrorResponse(http.StatusNotFound, "User not found")

	if err := app.ListenGraceful(":3000"); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

## Configuration (`repr.Config`)

`gota.New(cfg)` / `repr.New(cfg)` accepts `repr.Config`:

- `Title` (`string`, default `"API Reference"`): OpenAPI `info.title` and Scalar page title.
- `Version` (`string`, default `"1.0.0"`): OpenAPI `info.version`.
- `Description` (`string`): OpenAPI `info.description` and TypeScript header comment.
- `DocsURL` (`string`, default `"/docs"`): Scalar UI route.
- `OpenAPIURL` (`string`, default `"/openapi.json"`): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON spec route.
- `DisableDocs` (`bool`): Disables `/docs` and `/openapi.json` routes.
- `Scalar` (`scalar.Config`): Visual and security settings for Scalar UI.
- `Servers` (`[]repr.OpenAPIServer`): OpenAPI `servers` entries.
- `SecuritySchemes` (`map[string]repr.OpenAPISecurityScheme`): OpenAPI `components.securitySchemes`.
- `DocsMiddlewares` (`[]func(http.Handler) http.Handler`): Middlewares applied ONLY to docs and OpenAPI routes (e.g. `middleware.BasicAuth`). Docs routes run on an isolated router (`docsMux`) and do not inherit `app.Use(...)` middlewares such as CORS.
- `MaxBodyBytes` (`int64`, default `10 MiB`): Max request body read limit.
- `MaxMultipartMemory` (`int64`, default `32 MiB`): Max memory for `ParseMultipartForm`.
- `MaxHeaderBytes` (`int`, default `1 MiB`), `ReadTimeout` (`30s`), `WriteTimeout` (`30s`), `IdleTimeout` (`120s`): HTTP server limits (negative timeout disables that timeout).
- `DisallowUnknownFields` (`bool`): Rejects unknown fields when decoding JSON request bodies.
- `SilenceTagWarnings` (`bool`): Suppresses startup security warnings for sensitive field names without `json:"-"`.

## Server Lifecycle

- `app.Listen(addr)`: Starts `http.Server` (accepts `":3000"`, `"3000"`, or `"host:3000"`).
- `app.ListenGraceful(addr, shutdownTimeout...)`: Starts the server and gracefully shuts down on `SIGINT` / `SIGTERM` (default shutdown timeout: `10s`).
- `app.ServeHTTP(w, r)`: `App` implements `http.Handler` for custom server wiring or `httptest`.
- `app.Router() *chi.Mux`: Exposes the underlying chi router.

## Defining Endpoints

### 1. Function-Based REPR Endpoints

Register typed handlers with `repr.Get`, `repr.Post`, `repr.Put`, `repr.Patch`, or `repr.Delete`:

```go
repr.Post(app, "/todos", func(ctx *repr.Context, req CreateTodoRequest) (TodoResponse, error) {
	return createTodo(req), nil
}).
	Status(http.StatusCreated).
	Summary("Create a todo").
	Tags("Todos")
```

Use `repr.Empty` (or `struct{}{}`) when an endpoint has no request input or no response body. Returning `repr.Empty{}` automatically writes `204 No Content`.

### 2. Struct-Based REPR Endpoints

Implement `repr.Endpoint[Req, Res]` (`Handle(ctx *repr.Context, req Req) (Res, error)`) and register with `repr.HandleEndpoint`:

```go
type GetTodoEndpoint struct {
	Store *TodoStore
}

func (e *GetTodoEndpoint) Handle(_ *repr.Context, req GetTodoRequest) (TodoResponse, error) {
	todo, ok := e.Store.Find(req.ID)
	if !ok {
		return TodoResponse{}, repr.NotFound("Todo not found")
	}
	return todo, nil
}

repr.HandleEndpoint(app, http.MethodGet, "/todos/{id}", &GetTodoEndpoint{Store: store}).
	Summary("Get todo by ID").
	Tags("Todos").
	ErrorResponse(http.StatusNotFound, "Todo not found")
```

### 3. Non-REPR and Standard `net/http` Routes

- `app.Get`, `app.Post`, `app.Put`, `app.Patch`, `app.Delete`, `app.Route(method, path, handler)` — Register `func(ctx *repr.Context) error` handlers that can still be documented in OpenAPI/Scalar/TypeScript using `.Request(...)`, `.Param(...)`, `.Response(...)`, and `.ResponseMedia(...)`.
- `app.HandleHTTP(method, path, httpHandler)` — Register a standard `http.Handler` exposed in OpenAPI/Scalar/TypeScript.
- `app.Handle(method, path, httpHandler)` — Register an undocumented standard `http.Handler` directly on chi.

```go
app.Get("/health", func(ctx *repr.Context) error {
	return ctx.JSON(HealthStatus{Status: "ok"})
}).
	Summary("Health check").
	Tags("System").
	Response(http.StatusOK, HealthStatus{}, "Service health status")
```

## Route Metadata Builders (`*repr.Route`)

All REPR and documented non-REPR registration methods return `*repr.Route`:

- `.Summary(s)` / `.Description(d)` / `.OperationID(id)`
- `.Tags(tags...)` — Adds OpenAPI tags. All tags appear in OpenAPI; the TypeScript SDK uses the first tag as the module name (falling back to the first meaningful static path segment, or `default` when none exists). Explicit route/child-group tags take precedence ahead of parent `Group.Tags(...)`.
- `.Security(schemes...)` — Adds OpenAPI security requirements. Known names `BearerAuth`/`bearerAuth` and `BasicAuth`/`basicAuth` are auto-populated in `components.securitySchemes` if not explicitly defined in `Config.SecuritySchemes`.
- `.Deprecated()` / `.Hidden()` — Marks deprecated or omits from OpenAPI & TypeScript output.
- `.Status(code)` — Overrides the default `200` success status code in OpenAPI and at runtime (unless `ctx.Status(...)` is called explicitly).
- `.ErrorResponse(status, description, model...)` — Documents an error status (defaults to `repr.ErrorResponse{}`).
- `.Response(status, model, description...)` / `.ResponseMedia(status, contentType, model, description...)` — Documents responses (mainly for non-REPR routes or multiple status codes).
- `.Request(model, description...)` / `.Param(in, name, model, required, description...)` — Documents inputs on non-REPR routes (`in`: `"path"`, `"query"`, or `"header"`).

## Middlewares & Route Groups

Gota uses standard `func(http.Handler) http.Handler` middlewares and chi's ordering rule (`Use` must be called before registering routes).

```go
app.Use(middleware.RequestID, middleware.Logger, middleware.Recoverer)

api := app.Group("/api/v1").Security("BearerAuth").Tags("Account")
api.Use(authMiddleware)

repr.Get(api, "/me", getProfileHandler)

admin := api.Group("/admin", adminOnlyMiddleware).Tags("Admin")
repr.Delete(admin, "/users/{id}", deleteUserHandler)
```

- `Group` supports `Use`, `Security`, `Tags` (inherited by routes and nested subgroups; child/route tags take precedence for SDK module grouping), `Group` (nested), `Route`, `Get`, `Post`, `Put`, `Patch`, `Delete`, `HandleHTTP`, and all `repr.Get`/`Post`/`Put`/`Patch`/`Delete`/`HandleEndpoint` functions.

## Request Binding & Struct Tags

Gota binds request structs from URL path parameters, query parameters, headers, forms/multipart uploads, and JSON bodies:

| Tag | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `param:"id"` | URL path param `{id}` | Required automatically. Panics at startup if `{id}` is missing from route path. Do NOT use `path:"..."`. |
| `query:"page"` | Query string | Supports slices via repeated keys (`?tag=a&tag=b`) or comma-separated values. |
| `header:"X-Api-Key"` | Request header | Bound from `r.Header.Get(...)`. |
| `form:"avatar"` | Form / Multipart | Sets OpenAPI content type to `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, or `multipart/form-data` when a field is `*multipart.FileHeader` or `[]*multipart.FileHeader`. Use `form:"-"` to ignore. |
| `json:"title"` | JSON body | Use `json:"-"` to exclude from JSON, OpenAPI, and TypeScript. |
| `validate:"..."` | Validation rules | `go-playground/validator/v10` rules (`required`, `min=3`, `max=50`, `len=6`, `oneof=low normal high`, `email`, `url`, `uuid`, `omitempty`, `nowarn`). Reflected in OpenAPI (`minLength`, `minimum`, `enum`, `format`, `required`) and TypeScript (`oneof` on strings becomes a literal union). |
| `msg:"..."` | Custom error messages | Single message (`msg:"Todo ID is required"`) or pipe-delimited per-rule (`msg:"required:Title is required|min:Too short"`). Requires a `validate` tag. Do NOT use `message:"..."`. |
| `doc:"..."` | Description | Populates OpenAPI description and TypeScript JSDoc. |
| `example:"..."` | Example value | Typed OpenAPI example and `@example` JSDoc tag. |
| `default:"..."` | Default value | OpenAPI `default` and `@default` JSDoc tag. |
| `format:"..."` | OpenAPI format | Overrides OpenAPI `format` and `@format` JSDoc tag. |
| `deprecated:"true"` | Deprecation flag | Adds `@deprecated` in TypeScript JSDoc. |

Supported scalar types for `param`/`query`/`header`/`form`: `string`, `int*`, `uint*`, `float*`, `bool` (`true/1/t/yes/y`, `false/0/f/no/n`), `time.Time` (`RFC3339Nano`, `RFC3339`, `YYYY-MM-DD`), `encoding.TextUnmarshaler`, pointers, slices, and anonymous embedded structs.

Security guarantee: fields tagged exclusively with `param`, `query`, `header`, or `form` (without `json`) are zeroed after JSON decoding so JSON payloads cannot spoof path/query/header fields.

Startup tag checks fail fast (panic on route registration) for common mistakes such as `path:"..."`, `message:"..."`, `msg` without `validate`, options on `param`/`query`/`header`/`form` (like `query:"id,omitempty"`), invalid `validate` tags, or `param` tags absent from the route path.

### Response Headers

Fields on a response struct tagged with `header:"X-Total-Count"` write that HTTP header on non-zero values and are documented in OpenAPI `responses.<status>.headers`.

## Validation & Error Handling

### Validation

- Automatic validation runs before the handler and returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` with `repr.ValidationError`:
  ```json
  { "message": "Validation failed", "errors": { "title": ["Title is required"] }, "status": 422 }
  ```
- Register custom validator rules with `repr.RegisterValidation(tag, fn)`.
- Implement `repr.Validator` (`Validate() error`) or `repr.ContextValidator` (`Validate(ctx *repr.Context) error`) on request structs for cross-field validation.

### Error Helpers & Custom Error Handler

Return typed HTTP errors from handlers:
- `repr.BadRequest(msg)` (400)
- `repr.Unauthorized(msg)` (401)
- `repr.Forbidden(msg)` (403)
- `repr.NotFound(msg)` (404)
- `repr.Conflict(msg)` (409)
- `repr.UnprocessableEntity(msg)` (422)
- `repr.InternalServerError(msg)` (500)
- `repr.NewHTTPError(status, msg)`

`*repr.HTTPError` renders as `repr.ErrorResponse` (`{"error": "...", "status": 404, "requestId": "..."}`). Any custom error implementing `HTTPStatus() int` is serialized directly as JSON with that HTTP status. Unhandled errors return `500`. Override `app.ErrorHandler = func(ctx *repr.Context, err error) { ... }` to customize.

## Streaming & Server-Sent Events (SSE)

Return `repr.SSEStream` (or a custom `repr.Streamer` / `repr.StreamFunc`) from a REPR endpoint. Gota clears the HTTP write deadline automatically, sets OpenAPI media type to `text/event-stream` (`application/octet-stream` for generic `Streamer`), and types the TypeScript SDK response as `ReadableStream<string>`.

```go
repr.Get(app, "/events", func(ctx *repr.Context, _ repr.Empty) (repr.SSEStream, error) {
	ch := make(chan repr.SSEvent)
	go func() {
		defer close(ch)
		ch <- repr.SSEvent{Event: "update", Data: map[string]string{"status": "ready"}}
	}()
	return repr.SSEStream{Events: ch}, nil
})
```

Imperative helpers on `*repr.Context`: `ctx.SSEvent(event, data)` and `ctx.Stream(func(w io.Writer) bool)`.

## `*repr.Context` Reference

- Request info: `ctx.Context()`, `ctx.Param(name)`, `ctx.Header(key)`, `ctx.RequestID()`, `ctx.Cookie(name)`, `ctx.Body()`, `ctx.DecodeJSON(data, target)`
- Response writing: `ctx.Status(code)`, `ctx.SetHeader(key, val)`, `ctx.SetCookie(cookie)`, `ctx.JSON(data)`, `ctx.NoContent()`, `ctx.Redirect(url, code...)`, `ctx.RedirectLocal(target, code...)`, `ctx.Stream(...)`, `ctx.SSEvent(event, data)`
- State checks: `ctx.StatusCode()`, `ctx.StatusExplicit()`, `ctx.Written()`

## OpenAPI 3.1 & Scalar Docs

- OpenAPI 3.1 spec is available at `Config.OpenAPIURL` (default `/openapi.json`), programmatically via `app.OpenAPISpec()`, or exported via `app.ExportOpenAPI("openapi.json")`.
- Scalar API Reference UI is served at `Config.DocsURL` (default `/docs`) using `@scalar/api-reference` pinned with Subresource Integrity (SRI) and security headers (`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `Content-Security-Policy`).
- Available `scalar.Theme` constants: `ThemeDefault`, `ThemeAlternate`, `ThemeMoon`, `ThemePurple`, `ThemeSolarized`, `ThemeBluePlanet`, `ThemeDeepSpace`, `ThemeSaturn`, `ThemeKepler`, `ThemeElysiaJS`, `ThemeFastify` (default), `ThemeMars`, `ThemeLaserwave`, `ThemeNone`.
- `scalar.Handler(cfg)` can also be mounted standalone on any `http.ServeMux` or `chi` router.

## TypeScript SDK & Offline Codegen

Gota generates a modular, zero-dependency `fetch` client (`createGotaClient`) typed via `GotaEndpoints`.

### Programmatic Export & CLI Codegen

Generate the modular SDK during development or CI/CD via `RunCodegen`:

```go
if handled, err := app.RunCodegen(os.Args[1:]); handled {
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	return
}
```

Supported `RunCodegen` CLI flags:
- `--ts-sdk` (defaults to `./dist`) / `--ts-sdk=<dir>` — modular TypeScript client SDK directory (`index.ts`, `runtime.ts`, `types/<module>.ts`, `types/_shared.ts`, `endpoints/<module>.ts`)
- `--ts-import-ext=<ext>` — relative import suffix in `--ts-sdk`: `""`/`none` (default, bundlers), `".js"` (`node16`/`nodenext` ESM), `".ts"` (Node type stripping, Deno, Bun), or `"auto"` (autodetect from nearest `deno.json(c)`, `tsconfig.json`, or `package.json`)
- `--check` — CI verification mode; verifies exported SDK matches current routes (no missing, modified, or stale managed files) without writing to disk

Direct export & utility methods: `app.GenerateTypeScriptSDK(opts...)`, `app.ExportTypeScriptSDK(dir, opts...)`, `app.CheckTypeScriptSDK(dir, opts...)`, and `repr.DetectTypeScriptImportExtension(dir)`.

### Modular Layout & Project Extensions

Running `--ts-sdk=./src/lib/sdk` splits schemas and `GotaEndpoints` by module (`types/<module>.ts`, `types/_shared.ts`, `endpoints/<module>.ts`), using the route's first tag (inherited from `Group.Tags(...)` or set via `route.Tags(...)`) or falling back to the first meaningful static path segment (skipping leading `api` / `v[0-9]+`, falling back to `default` only for `/` or param-only paths). It isolates the route-independent core in `runtime.ts` and removes stale Gota-managed files on regeneration while preserving determinism for clean Git diffs.

Keep project-specific client configuration and domain helpers in a separate wrapper outside the generated directory (e.g., `src/lib/api.ts` importing from `./sdk`), so regenerating the SDK overwrites only the generated directory. In CI, run your codegen binary with `--ts-sdk=... --check` to catch forgotten SDK updates.

### Using the Generated TypeScript SDK

```ts
// src/lib/api.ts (project wrapper outside the generated ./sdk directory)
import {
  createGotaClient,
  isAbortError,
  isEndpointError,
  parseGotaError,
} from "./sdk";

export const api = createGotaClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000", {
  headers: async () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` }),
  timeoutMs: 8000,
  retry: 2,
});

export { isAbortError, isEndpointError, parseGotaError };
```

#### Error Parsing & Narrowing

Use `parseGotaError(err)` instead of custom error parsers to normalize HTTP errors, Gota `ValidationError` (`kind === "validation"` with `fieldErrors`), `ErrorResponse` (`requestId`), timeouts (`kind === "timeout"`), caller cancellations (`kind === "abort"`), and network failures (`kind === "network"`):

```ts
try {
  const created = await api.fetch("POST /todos", {
    body: { title: "Ship release", priority: "high" },
  });
} catch (err) {
  if (isEndpointError(err, "POST /todos")) {
    // err.data is narrowed to ResponseError<"POST /todos">
  }
  const parsed = parseGotaError(err);
  if (parsed.kind === "validation") {
    console.error(parsed.fieldErrors); // Record<string, string[]>
  } else {
    console.error(parsed.message, parsed.requestId);
  }
}
```

#### Frontend Hooks (TanStack Query / SWR) & Effect Cancellation

Prefer `api.queryOptions(...)` with a data-fetching library (or a thin service/hook layer) over calling `api.fetch` directly inside `useEffect`:

```ts
// TanStack Query: automatically passes { signal } and builds prefix-invalidatable keys
const todosQuery = useQuery(api.queryOptions("GET /todos", { query: { done: false } }));
// Invalidate any variant with: queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["GET /todos"] })

// SWR:
const { queryKey, queryFn } = api.queryOptions("GET /todos", { query: { done: false } });
const { data } = useSWR(queryKey, () => queryFn());
```

When using `useEffect` directly, pass an `AbortController.signal` and ignore `isAbortError(err)` (caller cancellations also automatically skip `onError` hooks):

```ts
useEffect(() => {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  api
    .fetch("GET /todos", { query: { done: false }, signal: controller.signal })
    .then(setTodos)
    .catch((err) => {
      if (isAbortError(err)) return;
      setError(parseGotaError(err).message);
    });
  return () => controller.abort();
}, []);
```

Client features: dynamic async `headers`, `credentials`, `cache`, Next.js `next` (`revalidate` / `tags`), `timeoutMs`, `retry` (exponential backoff with `Retry-After` support on idempotent methods), `onRequest`/`onResponse`/`onError` hooks, `AbortSignal` cancellation, `queryOptions` helper, `parseGotaError` / `isAbortError` / `isEndpointError`, automatic `FormData` (when `Blob`/`File` is present) and `URLSearchParams` encoding, and `ReadableStream<string>` for SSE responses.

## Security & Auditing Utilities

- **Sensitive field detection**: `repr.AuditModel(model)`, `app.AuditRoutes()`, and `repr.IsSensitiveFieldName(name)` check for exposed secret-like fields (`Password`, `PasswordHash`, `Secret`, `PrivateKey`, `AuthToken`, `CVV`, etc.) missing `json:"-"` / `form:"-"`. Use `validate:"nowarn"` on a specific field or `Config.SilenceTagWarnings: true` to suppress logs.
- **Upload filename sanitization**: `repr.SanitizeFilename(header.Filename)` strips directory traversal paths, control characters, and hidden dotfiles.
- **Safe local redirects**: `ctx.RedirectLocal(target, code...)` and `repr.IsLocalRedirectTarget(target)` reject external URLs, protocol-relative URLs (`//`), and backslashes with `400 Bad Request`.
